THESIS STATUS: INVALIDATED
ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 15%

OVERNIGHT SUMMARY: Major reversal in sentiment with S&P futures up 0.85% and VIX collapsing -5.33%. Bullish composite signal (0.2672) directly contradicts yesterday's 95% bearish call. Current volatility regime shifted to "explosive" with negative GEX creating unstable conditions.

KEY DEVELOPMENTS:
• All major US futures strongly positive (+0.81-0.90%)
• VIX collapse from ~31 to 29 signals fear reduction
• Negative GEX (-2.18B) with narrow range (615 put wall / 630 call wall)
• Asian markets mixed but European indices supporting risk-on
• Polymarket still bearish (-0.1817) creating divergence with price action

TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: EXIT
TRADE NOTES: Exit bear put spread immediately at market open. Gap up will crush put values, especially short 625P. Current ES at 6426 suggests SPY opening near 638+, well above our 630.37 breakeven. Cut losses quickly.

DAY AHEAD RISKS:
• Explosive volatility regime with negative GEX creates whipsaw potential
• Gap fill back to overnight lows possible
• Fed policy divergence (recession odds vs rate cut expectations)

DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:
• Short volatility plays if VIX continues collapse below 28
• Momentum continuation if we break above 630 call wall
• Potential fade setup if gap up fails on volume
